verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a user-facing bulk-operation capability, such as selecting and editing, updating, or acting on many items at once. The closest items are adjacent, not the capability itself. Group-based role assignment is a permissions control. Assumption changes cascading through a model is model recalculation. Excel push/pull is data sync.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
